fn idle() ->
    recv
        _msg -> idle()

fn burn(dst, 0) ->
    send(dst, :done)
    recv
        _msg -> ()
fn burn(dst, n) ->
    burn(dst, n - 1)

me = self()
spawn(() -> burn(me, 20000))
spawn(() -> idle())
top(0)
Repl.top(:n)
recv
    :done -> ()
top(2)
-- output --
me = #<pid 0>
#<pid 1>
#<pid 2>
error: raise: (:type_error, (:top, 0))
  at __repl__ (<repl>:1:1)
error: raise: (:type_error, (:top, :n))
  at __repl__ (<repl>:1:5)
#<pid 1>

#<pid 0>
{ reductions: _, alloc_bytes: _, mailbox: 0, dropped: 0, turn_reductions: _, turn_alloc_bytes: _, name: None, status: :running, watchers: [], watching: [], initial_fn: "<repl>" }
